G0.threshold: Motor VM physically disconnected; motor locked; no motor commands
G0.observed: Operator confirmed VM disconnected. Diagnostic firmware locked outputs and all valid-capture IRH records reported locked=1; no motor commands were sent.

G1.threshold: Native/build PASS; HELLO; >=95% IRF/IRB/IRH coverage; six channels; measured positive scan rate; malformed/drop/DMA/timeout/overrun/failure deltas zero
G1.observed: Full local workflow-equivalent checks passed. Eight transport-valid captures; minimum coverage IRF/IRB/IRH = 99.82/99.32/96.65%; scan 1209.69-1210.50 Hz; all error/drop deltas and malformed counts zero. Missing-HELLO attempts were correctly rejected.

G2.threshold: Three independent 20-second trials per in-range channel/distance with geometry and environment metadata
G2.observed: Three confirmed independent reseats at 50 mm in the two-side-wall configuration; 202026 independence unconfirmed. 40 mm is one setup plus same-fixture repeat. P0 white-wall 20 mm and other P1 distances are not measured; latest wall angle is unknown.

G3.threshold: SNR >=5 in intended use region; selected filter reduces STD >=25% at most tested distances without losing wall variation
G3.observed: Exploratory paired SNR exceeds 5 and hybrid median STD reduction is 44.4-55.9% across channels for six stationary 40/50 mm captures. Coverage, geometry, and dynamic wall-variation evidence are insufficient to accept a filter.

G4.threshold: At least 10 rising and falling events per region; timestamp resolution sufficient for v_target*latency <=5 mm
G4.observed: No intentional step/event series. UART IRF is 40 Hz and cannot certify a 5-10 ms response.

G5.threshold: Quantified false-positive/negative and cross-talk across light, material, angle, and position with no safety-relevant misclassification
G5.observed: Only white matte walls and room lighting were measured, in a two-side-wall configuration. No single-wall, alternate-light/material, or angle/position matrix.

G6.threshold: Per-channel monotonic LUT; independent holdout MAE <=2 mm and P95 absolute error <=5 mm; no extrapolation
G6.observed: No per-channel monotonic interval, LUT, or independent holdout.

filter_decision: No filter selected for production or Wall PID. EMA alpha 0.10 produced the strongest static STD suppression in the measured captures; hybrid also exceeded the static reduction target there. Dynamic latency and broader repeatability are unmeasured, so all candidates remain experimental.
retry_blocker: No global hardware blocker for motor-locked acquisition. Remaining qualification needs a 20 mm fixture for P0, three independent trials per valid distance with measured channel geometry, high-resolution dynamic timestamps, robustness matrix, and holdout calibration.
